thread:
maria: Morning — quick midday standup for the train. TL;DR: cut candidate queued, 3 cherry-picks pending, 1 blocker (flaky e2e). Details below.

jamie: Thanks. Which cherries are still blocked?

maria: CHERRIES:
- #3421 (fix/kv-cache-ttl) -> merged to rc but needs staging smoke ✅
- #3478 (lite-quant-fix) -> cherry-pick applied, failing one unit test (fp32 mismatch)
- #3499 (config/release-timeout) -> conflicts on pkg/deploy, holding

pranav: For #3478 I can take the unit test. Is it failing locally or only CI?

jamie: CI only so far. @pranav plz replicate with docker image: ghcr.io/redwood/inference/rc:2025-03-07 command:
``
docker run --rm -e ENV=staging ghcr.io/redwood/inference/rc:2025-03-07 ./run-tests --filter test_quant
```

alex: Infra note: autoscaler hit a provisioning delay in us-west2 this morning — we have one pending node for ~12m. Might affect canary perf numbers.

maria: Blocker: e2e-flakiness on integration tests (test_session_reconnect). Stacktrace points at race in reconnect handler. @jamie are you able to triage or should I?

jamie: I'm on it, will re-run w/ --run-long and attach logs. If reproduce, I'll open a revert PR.

release-bot: cut candidate created: rc-2025-03-03-17512 (id: rc-72513). Health: 92% green, 6 failing tests (mostly flakes).

maria: Action items:
- @pranav take #3478 unit fix (low risk)
- @jamie triage e2e flakes, re-run tests, capture env
- @alex monitor autoscaler / provisioner for canary
- @sara can you do a quick smoke on staging for #3421?

sara: On it, will do smoke in 15m.

jamie: quick heads-up — if e2e flakes persist, we should consider cutting without #3478 and run it as a post-cut patch. Thoughts?

maria: Fine by me if tests fail to stabilize by EOD. Document plan in the cut ticket. @release-bot add note: possible post-cut hotfix for #3478.

release-bot: note added to rc-72513.

pranav: grabbing #3478 now.

sara: staging smoke passed for #3421, no config drift observed 👍

maria: Great. I'll update the roll-forward checklist and ping on final go/no-go 4pm PT.

alex: FYI I'll also spin an extra node group in us-west2 as precaution.

jamie: Re-run done, attaching failing stack (link). Repro consistent locally, suspect race in session manager. Working on minimal repro.

maria: Thanks — keep updates here. If anyone needs merge approvals ping me directly for fast-track.
